assets.prompt_full: Edit this mascot sprite into Mochi's own distinct identity. Keep the same chibi egg pose, body position, size, framing, and plain warm-white background. Apply these owned Mochi deltas: (1) FUR SHADE: recolor the fleece to Mochi's muted rose-taupe, a soft desaturated rosy taupe-brown clearly rosier and cooler than oatmeal-cream, keeping dense visible short-pile strands and soft volumetric shading; keep the smooth matte porcelain face plate in warm cream. (2) FACE: bead eyes slightly LARGER, set a touch CLOSER together and HIGHER on the face plate, each with one white highlight dot; smile a warmer slightly WIDER single closed curve with gently upturned ends; blush circles slightly LARGER, placed LOWER and more outward on the cheeks. (3) ACCESSORIES (both fixed Mochi traits): keep the small plain pink belly pouch centered on the belly, AND add a small pastel-pink nurse cap tilted on the upper-left of the head with one tiny white cross emblem. (4) CLEAN EDGES: crisp smooth silhouette with gentle antialiased falloff, no jagged stair-steps, no pixel spikes, no halo; one faint compact grounding shadow tucked directly beneath the feet only. Soft 3D animated mascot character, chibi egg-shaped body, head and body merged with no neck, dense short-pile oatmeal-cream fleece fur with visible fur strands and soft volumetric shading, smooth matte porcelain face plate inset into the fur, small round glossy black bead eyes with white highlight dots set wide, soft diffused pink blush circles, one thin dark curved smile, stubby mitten arms and nub legs, no fingers or toes, no outline or line art of any kind, no cel shading, soft rim light, soft floor shadow, full body, centered, plain solid warm-white studio void background, game sprite. No text, no busy background, no extra limbs, no open mouth, no outline, no flat 2D, no neon colors, no clutter.
